title: Trump heads to Asia with hopes of shifting the momentum after midterm setbacks hurt him at home
description: President Donald Trump heads to Asia this week and he's aiming to shift the momentum after Republican losses in the midterm elections. Trump plans a historic meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss nuclear stockpiles. He's first visiting the Philippines on Tuesday to meet Southeast Asian leaders. Then it's on to China for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. The trip comes as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress in January and they may try to curb his foreign policy tools. Trump faces scrutiny over issues such as artificial intelligence and trade. The wars in Iran and Ukraine also loom over the trip.
content:
WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump heads to Asia this week, hoping to make some big attention-grabbing moves on the world stage after his party suffered deep losses in the midterm elections, diminishing his standing at home.

title: The reverse of AI: Beyond ChatGPT and Copilots, why companies are focusing on human skills over AI tools
description: Companies in India are integrating artificial intelligence into daily operations and recognizing the need for human skills. As AI changes workplace dynamics, leadership and analytical thinking become essential for making informed decisions. Organizations are shifting training focus to resilience, collaboration, and communication rather than solely technical skills. Effective adoption of AI tools now also necessitates a solid workplace culture fostering collaboration and accountability.
